text.tspan: Mean income per month within the poorest decile (after tax)1963 to 2024
Mean income per month within the poorest decile (tenth of the population). This data is adjusted for inflation
and differences in living costs between countries. Income here is measured after taxes and benefits.
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Income has been equivalized.
